India Squads Announced for Afghanistan T20Is and Asian Games

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced the squads for the upcoming T20 International series against Afghanistan and the Asian Games. Shreyas Iyer has been named captain for the T20Is against Afghanistan, while Jasprit Bumrah has been included in the squad, subject to fitness clearance. Four players in total require fitness clearance before the Afghanistan series. The squads were announced by the BCCI.
